description: This file contains Lua functions for parsing documentation comments, extracting parameters, descriptions, examples, and generating method declarations. It also includes functions to parse header files and generate module documentation.

methods.name: from_md
methods.description: Converts markdown text with inline code delimiters into HTML with <code> tags.

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter string into a table with name and description.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts and formats the description part of a comment, excluding tags like @param and @example.

methods.name: parse_bottom_description
methods.description: Extracts the bottom part of the description from a comment, handling @example and @param tags.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Parses the @return tag from a comment to extract variable name and description.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Extracts example code blocks from comments, including live examples and call indices.

methods.name: parse_calls
methods.description: Parses @call and @param tags within comments to build a list of method calls with arguments.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Parses a documentation comment block to extract method info, including name, type, description, examples, calls, and return info.

methods.name: get_declaration
methods.description: Generates a method call string with arguments based on method name and parameters.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Creates a list of method call strings for all calls in a method.

methods.name: parse_params
methods.description: Extracts all @param tags from a comment into a list of parameter tables.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses a source file to extract documented methods and callback functions with their documentation.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Finds header files in a directory, parses them, and returns module documentation including methods.
